solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

**The misspelled word is 'Deciet'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Deceit'.**
 
• The word '**Deceit**' is a **noun** which means 'the action or practice of deceiving someone by concealing or misrepresenting the truth'. **(धोखाधड़ी)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• She was accused of using deceit to gain information.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Deciet'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Fright -** a sudden intense feeling of fear **(डर)**
 
• **Anomaly -** something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected **(असामान्यता)**
 
• **Consistent -** acting or done in the same way over time, especially so as to be fair or accurate **(सुसंगत)**
